message.name: IntraBalanceMovementCancellationReportV02
message.definition: The IntraBalanceMovementCancellationReport message is sent from a settlement infrastructure to an account owner/requestor to provide full details or current status values of the intra-balance movement cancellation request(s), as defined within the query.||The message may also be used to: |- re-send a message previously sent (the sub-function of the message is "Duplicate") |- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy") |- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy Duplicate").

rules.name: ReportNumberRule
rules.text: If Long number (Exact5NumericTest) is used, then the report must be a delta reports (UpdateType: DELT).|If the report has multiple pages, then the ReportNumber must remain the same through all the pages. It is a unique number to the report.|Two reports of the same type sent one after the other to the same receiver in relation to the same safekeeping account must have different ReportNumbers. For example, a daily report sent on day 1 would have ReportNumber 001, on day 2, 002, etc.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or Proxy must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: AdditionalReasonInforrmationRule
rules.text: The AdditionalReasonInformation element must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed.

rules.name: AdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the sender and the receiver, if InstructionProcessingAdditionalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: BalanceFromToRule
rules.text: The cash balance type of BalanceFrom must be different from the cash balance type of BalanceTo.

rules.name: CashAccountRule
rules.text: CashAccount must be present or Cancellation(*)/CashAccount must be present, but not both.

rules.name: CashAccountOwnerRule
rules.text: CashAccountOwner must be present or Cancellation(*)/AccountOwner must be present, but not both.

rules.name: ProcessingStatusRule
rules.text: ProcessingStatus must be present or Cancellation(*)/ProcessingStatus must be present, but not both.

rules.name: CashAccountServicerRule
rules.text: CashAccountServicer must be present or Cancellation(*)/AccountOwner must be present, but not both.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: ActivityIndicatorYesRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is equal to Yes (true or 1) then ReportOrError must be present.

rules.name: ActivityIndicatorNoRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is equal to No (false or 0) then ReportOrError must be absent.

rules.name: QueryTypeFullRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/QueryType is equal to Full, then ReportOrError/Cancellations(*)/Cancellation/TransactionIdentification and ReportOrError/Cancellations(*)/Cancellation/UnderlyingIntraBalance must be present.

rules.name: QueryTypeStatusRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/QueryType is equal to Status, then ReportOrError/Cancellations(*)/Cancellation/TransactionIdentification and ReportOrError/Cancellations(*)/Cancellation/UnderlyingIntraBalance must be absent.
